compiler.evmVersionRationale: PUSH0 is universally available but Cancun opcodes are not; shanghai is the portable floor that keeps Arc a future deployment target rather than a rewrite.

supersedes.note: Replaces the pre-rename Datum-named deployment (same deployer, same publisher key, same treasury/feeBps). Nothing had ever been publicly published against the old addresses — no real print was ever anchored, only synthetic smoke-test hashes — so this is a clean cutover with no migration path needed.

TouchstoneAttestation.notes: publisher is the EOA of TOUCHSTONE_PUBLISHER_KEY, the same key packages/print signs prints with (compressed pubkey 0x030c598ee35bd24b6942e9155bd36c1dbbe77936c700f859e75b0168b0e25cb299), so the key that signs a print is the key that anchors it. Immutable: rotating the publisher means deploying a new instance. Same publisher key as the superseded Datum-named deployment — reused, not regenerated.

TouchstoneEscrow.feeBpsMeaning: 50 basis points = 0.50%, charged on actualAmount only and deducted from seller proceeds. Contract cap MAX_FEE_BPS = 100 (1%).
TouchstoneEscrow.minSettlementMeaning: New in this deployment. Below 100 minor units, settle() reverts (SettlementTooSmall) rather than silently charging a fee integer division would truncate to zero — the console's first live run against the prior deployment found real sub-200-unit settlements paying no fee at all. At or above 100, a configured nonzero feeBps always takes at least 1 unit, capping the floor's effective rate at 1% (1 unit on a 100-unit settlement), the same rate MAX_FEE_BPS already permits. actualAmount == 0 (a full refund via settle()) is exempt from the floor — unchanged behaviour. A feeBps == 0 deployment never has the floor manufacture a fee, since it explicitly configured no fee.
TouchstoneEscrow.notes: treasury and feeBps are immutable with no setter. Treasury here is the deployer EOA, acceptable on testnet only.

mainnetRequirements: treasury MUST be a Safe/multisig, not an EOA. It is immutable with no setter, so a lost key makes fee revenue permanently unrecoverable and the only remedy is redeploying the escrow and migrating every integrator.
Generate TOUCHSTONE_PUBLISHER_KEY on an air-gapped machine. The testnet key used here has passed through repository-adjacent files.
Deploy.s.sol is chain-guarded to 84532; a mainnet deployment needs its own script and its own review.

1_anchorRealPrint.description: Signed the worked example from docs/siu-worked-example.md locally (reproduces Dated SIU $0.0383), anchored its real body hash, confirmed the recovered signer matches publisher() on-chain, then confirmed re-anchoring a hash reverts. This is a worked example, not a production print — none has been published yet.

reAnchorTest.description: A separate synthetic body hash, anchored and then re-anchored to confirm the revert independently of the worked-example print.

2_escrowSettleBelowMax.description: Full cycle with real USDC, settler = address(0). Fee charged on actualAmount only; buyer refund excludes fee. Well above the new MIN_SETTLEMENT floor, so the raw feeBps formula alone governs — unaffected by the fix.

assertedOnChain.provenBy: seller's cumulative USDC balance across all of this run's settlements (7262) matched the sum independently predicted from every individual settle amount and the feeBps/MIN_SETTLEMENT formula exactly, cross-validating every step below

3_escrowExpiryReclaim.description: Second quote taken to a real (30-second) expiry, then expire() reclaimed by the buyer after waiting for it on the wall clock. No fee is taken on an expiry refund.

4_quoteHashNotReusable.description: A quoteHash is single-use forever, whether it was settled or expired.

5_feeFloorBoundaries.description: New in this deployment. Live confirmation of MIN_SETTLEMENT and the fee-floor formula at the exact boundaries: 99 reverts, 100/199/1000 pay the formula's predicted fee. Each amount used its own fresh escrow (maxAmount 2000) on the same seller.

amount100.expected: fee 1, seller receives 99 — 100 * 50 / 10000 == 0 raw, floored to 1

amount199.expected: fee 1, seller receives 198 — 199 * 50 / 10000 == 0 raw, floored to 1

amount1000.expected: fee 5, seller receives 995 — 1000 * 50 / 10000 == 5 raw, floor inactive (raw already nonzero)
